curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with the tire pressure and tread checks, then the steps before and after starting the engine.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per check; the pre-drive and post-start routines as ordered lists.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what to check before and just after starting the engine.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the three purposes of signs, every sign color and shape, regulatory and warning signs, route shields, and work-area signs and devices.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each color and shape group; contrast cards for circle versus crossbuck and pentagon versus pennant.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a sign's color or shape in words and asking what it means.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover where to stop at a stop sign, stopping where no line exists, four-way stops, yield signs, and pulling over for emergency vehicles.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each stop and yield rule; a contrast card for stop versus yield.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on who goes first and where to stop.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain dark signals, red, yellow and green lights, flashing lights, every arrow, and when turns on red are allowed.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each light and arrow; contrast cards for the three yellow indications, right versus left on red, and flashing red versus an outage.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a signal and asking what the driver must do.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover how pedestrians follow traffic and walk signals, where pedestrian deaths happen, then crossing guards, school-zone speed limits and school-zone U-turns.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each pedestrian signal and school-zone rule; a contrast card for the two school-zone limits.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on pedestrian signals and school-zone limits.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach white and yellow lines, solid and broken lines, double yellow lines, crosswalks, stop and dotted lines, and the center left-turn lane limits.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each marking; contrast cards for broken versus solid white and white versus yellow.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a line and asking whether passing or crossing is allowed.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover railroad warning signs, where to stop, who must always stop, gates and lights, the parking limit near tracks, multiple tracks and what to do if you stall.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each crossing rule; a contrast card for the fifteen-foot stopping distance versus the fifty-foot parking limit.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on stopping, gates and stalls at railroad crossings.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec04-m01..sec04-m07; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact
